name: Couples
prompts: What did you think of me the first time we met? Be honest.
What's something small I do that you'd miss if I stopped?
Where were we the last time you remember laughing really hard together?
What's one thing you've wanted to ask me but never have?
If we had a completely free weekend, what would you actually want to do?
What's a habit of mine you've quietly got used to?
What's the best decision we've made together?
What did you imagine your life would look like at this age?
When do you feel most like yourself around me?
What's something you'd like us to do more of?
What's a conversation we keep avoiding?
What do you think I'd say is your best quality?
What's the kindest thing anyone has done for you?
What's something you've never told anyone at this table?
If we could go back to one day together, which one?
What are you looking forward to that you haven't mentioned?
What's one thing you need more of from me?
What's a tiny thing that makes your day better?
